run_inception_metrics_evaluation: run the Tester class to compute FID, IS, and PRDC metrics for a GAN model
run_tester_on_slurm: run the Tester class via submitit SlurmExecutor for distributed GAN evaluation on a cluster
run_local_debug_evaluation: run the Tester class in local_debug mode to evaluate GAN metrics without a cluster
create_tester_with_config: create a Tester instance with a config dict to evaluate a BigGAN model's sample quality
sample_images_to_pickle: sample generated images from a BigGAN model and save them as pickle files for TF-Inception
